psnr.description: Global reconstruction fidelity on held-out sample colors.

ssim.description: Global structural similarity proxy for the reconstructed color field.

l1_error.description: Mean absolute color error across held-out samples.

tail_l1_p95.description: Ninety-fifth percentile per-sample absolute color error, penalizing localized failures hidden by averages.

bright_l1_error.description: Mean absolute error on the brightest quartile of target samples, which catches methods that mostly fit easy low-intensity regions.

channel_bias_l1.description: Absolute mean residual across color channels, penalizing systematic color bias.

num_points.description: Normalized Gaussian primitive count, the main compactness constraint.

point_reduction_vs_adc.description: Fractional primitive reduction relative to the ADC baseline under the same output contract.

flops_proxy.description: Machine-independent rendering-cost proxy proportional to primitives times evaluated samples.

splits.description: Total densification split count, discouraging unnecessary growth operations.
